# Temple Scroll Column 23 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** 11Q19 (Cave 11), Col. 23 | **Condition:** well preserved

---

**23:1** And you shall sacrifice upon it your burnt offerings and your peace offerings, your tithes and the offering of your hands and all your choice votive offerings which you shall vow to Me.

**23:2** And you shall eat there before Me with rejoicing, you and your households, your sons and your daughters, your menservants and your maidservants, and the Levite who is within your gates, for he has no portion or inheritance with you.

**23:3** Take heed to yourself that you do not offer your burnt offerings in every place that you see, but only in the place which I shall choose in one of your tribes; there you shall offer your burnt offerings.

**23:4** And there you shall do all that I command you: your burnt offerings and your sacrifices, your tithes and the offering of your hands and all the choice of your vows which you vow to Me.

**23:5** And you shall not offer upon it any strange incense or burnt offering or grain offering; and you shall not pour a drink offering upon it that is not prescribed.

**23:6** And you shall sacrifice the peace offerings, and you shall eat there and rejoice before Me at your appointed feasts.

**23:7** And you shall offer upon the altar the daily burnt offering, a lamb of the first year, unblemished, in the morning; and the second lamb you shall offer between the evenings.

**23:8** And a tenth of fine flour mixed with a quarter of a hin of beaten oil; and a drink offering, a quarter of a hin of wine — a fire-offering, a pleasing aroma to Me, the LORD.

**23:9** And on the Sabbath day, two lambs of the first year, unblemished, and two-tenths of fine flour mixed with oil as a grain offering, and its drink offering.

**23:10** This is the burnt offering of the Sabbath, each Sabbath, in addition to the daily burnt offering and its drink offering.

**23:11** And you shall make atonement upon its horns once in the year; with the blood of the sin offering of atonement once in the year he shall make atonement upon it.

**23:12** Throughout your generations it shall be most holy to Me, the LORD.

**23:13** And at the beginnings of your months you shall offer a burnt offering to Me: two bulls of the herd, and one ram, and seven lambs of the first year, unblemished.

**23:14** And three-tenths of fine flour mixed with oil as a grain offering for each bull, and two-tenths of fine flour mixed with oil as a grain offering for the one ram.

**23:15** And a tenth of fine flour mixed with oil as a grain offering for each lamb; a burnt offering, a fire-offering, a pleasing aroma to Me, the LORD.

**23:16** And their drink offerings: a half of a hin for the bull, a third of a hin for the ram, and a quarter of a hin for the lamb, of wine. This is the monthly burnt offering, month by month, for the months of the year.

---

*EMET notes: Column 23 well preserved. Sacrificial regulations draw on Numbers 28-29 and Deuteronomy 12:5-7 reformulated in divine first person. "Between the evenings" (bein ha-arbayim) preserved literally. Measurement terms (hin, tenth, etc.) retained.*
